descriptionHtml:
缺陷 A4 · P2 · 无障碍

多处文字对比度不达 AA（问卷按钮 3.66:1，Previous Notes 标题 2.5:1，dashboard 房号行等）

票：— · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地（视觉巡检）

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-13/S22, TC-20/S18, TC-25/S21

思路 / Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S24a 「医院和养老院列表上的 baseline 问卷卡片在桌面和手机上通过 axe」 Baseline survey card on the Hospital and Nursing Home lists passes axe on desktop and phones

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U10 A one-time baseline survey is shown before the physician adds their first patient（UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 2；TFA-94514 AC 4；TFA-94609 AC 7）

测试设计方法：无障碍（accessibility） — 按读屏、键盘、对比度、点按尺寸的规则（axe）查，残障用户也要能用。

Given Visual lane profiles desktop, Pixel 7, iPhone 15 on a fresh account (baseline card on the lists)

When axe on /rounding and /snf with the baseline card (the visual lane's hospital-list and nh-list screens)

Then No serious or critical WCAG 2 A/AA violations on the card; Start survey and Not now have accessible names and are reachable by keyboard; tap targets >= 24 px and no sideways scroll on phones

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：axe-core violations (serious/critical) = 0; accessible-name and tap-size checks from visual-checks.ts (evidence for a human per visual-lane). Only these two screens: the dialogs, Settings and Nursing Home Post-Round are S24b

在哪跑：本地 visual lane（截图 + axe）；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 视觉 / 移动端（automated）

S24a 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-06.matrix.json 里的编号；字母后缀 = 一个用例拆成了几条），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：无障碍 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94514 ready for qa；TFA-94609 ready for pr

医院和养老院列表上基线问卷卡片的「Start survey」按钮是白字配青绿底，对比度 3.66:1，低于要求的 4.5:1。

The 'Start survey' button on the baseline survey card is white on teal at 3.66:1, below the 4.5:1 contrast required, on both the Hospital and Nursing Home lists.

依据：allure be679cfc-…-result.json; runs/2026-10-14-local/visual/evidence/OAT-06_S24a: 22 checks pass, 6 fail (a serious axe color-contrast violation on desktop, iPhone 15 and Pixel 7). Names, Tab reach, tap size and no sideways scroll pass.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane visual。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：visual。

UAT item: OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-06/S24a

Baseline survey card on the Hospital and Nursing Home lists passes axe on desktop and phones

Tickets: TFA-94514 Analytics tracking (ready for qa); TFA-94609 Pilot Surveys (ready for pr)

本地新 lane visual：visual/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（visual/plan.json，automatable: yes）：lists.spec.ts: fresh account without the baseline snooze; axe scoped to the baseline card on /rounding and /snf; Start survey / Not now names; Tab reach (desktop, Pixel 7); tap >= 24 px and no sideways scroll on phones.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 22 judged check(s) passed, 6 failed.

产品问题：The 'Start survey' button on the baseline card is white on teal-600 (3.66:1, needs 4.5:1) — a serious axe contrast violation on the card on both lists (oracle: serious/critical = 0). Names, Tab reach, tap size and no sideways scroll pass.

证据：附了 5 个；没附 1 个：

  • visual/evidence/OAT-06_S24a — 目录（15 项），不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev; the baseline card also needs an account that has not answered the baseline, which the shared dev account cannot be made into.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
